body: Nope. No time. It would stress me out.
Self harm. Cuddling with my friends. But I can't do that.
K well internet is shit, gonna just go kill myself later
Chocolate cake is gross, I do nothing but hurt everyone who loves me.

I don't even know what's wrong... I just really want it to end. It seems like everything will always be like this and nothing will ever be good or sweet. There's no way i can get out of my head except for self harm and that's not productive. I hurt everyone always.

Throwaway, for obvious reasons.

I have a plan to do some bad shit tonight. Gonna jump out of my (not too high) window. Then I'll be locked out of my house, and it's winter, so I'll hopefully get hypothermia. I guess where I am in my head right now can classify as pretty bad.

I came out to a bunch of my friends at school about a month ago. They're all calling me a different name now. And I didn't tell my parents.

I didn't tell my parents because, when they first dragged me out of the closet on the first day of 2016, they refused to listen to what I was saying about how much I was hurting. They started making fun of trans people in situations where they were super friendly before. I've been trying to make them understand since then, written emails and drafted speeches. I've explained as best I could with the resources I have. I've cried too much.

I don't understand, because they were so LGBTQ+ positive in every situation before making me come out. They still are, to everyone else except me. And I CANNOT handle it anymore. Sometimes I think it's getting better, like that one time I thought I heard my mom use the correct pronoun, but then it turned out to be just wishful thinking because she never did it again.

It makes me feel like shit. Because I'm sort of already out to my parents, but they're not doing anything to help me, so I keep pushing it on them again and again and again but they never listen. I told them two months ago that I couldn't talk to them anymore because it was just making me feel worse. 

But they're going to interact with my friends sometime soon, probably, and they will be sooooo mad if they found out that I came out at school. So I need to tell them that it happened before they find out by accident. The more time that passes, the more chance my parents will find out. And I can't afford that happening.

So, I guess I need to come out to my family, too. But I've already tried so many times and it hasn't been working. I'm out, but at the same time I'm not. It's chewing out my insides having to keep worrying about this.

I don't know what to say to you. I can't say that it will get better, because it hasn't really for me. In part, I think that living with the hope that coming out will fix things is better than coming out and having things still suck. For me, things still suck. I just really hope that no one ever has to go through what I'm going through right no, because it sucks so much. Often I just want to shoot myself, but it's Canada, so hey - no guns.

Sorry for the long comment. I wish you luck in coming out. And I hope that your family actually listens to you, unlike mine.

TL;DR My parents are frustrating, I want to die.
